description: This file defines a Java record named ProductSummaryResponse intended as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) that provides a summary view of a product for catalog listings. It includes product identifiers, merchant store ID, SKU, type, availability, and timestamp information, and is annotated with Swagger schema annotations for API documentation. It is used within a gateway context, specifically for preview purposes where downstream services are not invoked.

classes.name: ProductSummaryResponse
classes.description: A record representing a summarized view of a product for catalog listings, including IDs, SKU, type, availability, and timestamps.
